name: notes
description: Front 116 — an application's manifest. `bpp` is the whole configuration of the file kind: it names the ONE dependency whose `pub default fn` — a template function, jhonstart's `html` (decisions 198, 200) — this project's `.bpp` files unfold onto. For each file the toolchain copies the header between the two `---` lines into the module as written and hands everything after the second `---` to that function as its literal; it knows no tag and no library. A `.bpp` file is listed in `files` like any module.
